verdict.rationale: VPM's registered-agent service scans service-of-process and state legal notices same day they arrive (virtualpostmail-docs-5, -11, -20, -27), which directly addresses the legal-mail-deadline concern, and generic 'automation rules' (virtualpostmail-docs-2, -17) could in theory be used to flag such mail. However there is no evidence of an explicit flagging/prioritization mechanism, deadline alerts, or IRS-specific handling — missing for 10: dedicated flag/tag for government mail, deadline-reminder or alert feature, explicit IRS-mail handling, and any documented automation-rule example targeting legal/compliance categories.
